assets.description: Lidl's official logo featuring a bold blue square with a yellow circle and red accent. Clean, compact SVG suitable for top-left placement or lockup branding. Works as footer logo or header stamp on promotional banners.

Mobile app screenshot showing Lidl Plus loyalty program with 550 points reward display. Bright blue background with product examples (energy drink, baguette). Text-heavy interface; suitable as hero image for loyalty program promotions or can rotate within product carousel.

Wide leaderboard banner featuring camping tent promotion (CRIVIT brand) with 46% discount, price €21.99. Beach lifestyle scene with orange diagonal accent overlays. Clear promotional badges and date stamp. Ideal as full-width hero or can split into sections.

Mother's Day campaign leaderboard (blonde model, hair dryer, pink background). Features 40% discount messaging with bold red diamond badge and pink heart decorations. Price €29.99 prominently displayed in yellow. Emotional, seasonal appeal; rotates well as hero banner.

Alternative Mother's Day leaderboard (brunette variant of hair dryer promotion). Identical layout and messaging with 40% off, €29.99 price in yellow. Suitable for A/B testing or rotation within carousel; same color palette and typography as 2210604.

Product packshot of CRELANDO drawing set (premium art supplies kit) on bright blue background. Features 14% discount badge and price €29.99 in bold yellow. Online-only label prominent. Clean product isolation; excellent for hero display with strong visual hierarchy.

Bicolored apples promotion (3 kg bag) on deep red background with natural product photography. Features 34% discount, price €2.97, and Lidl Plus logo badge. White and yellow text overlay. Fresh, organic appeal; can serve as hero or rotate in grocery promotion carousel.
